prerequisites.required_endpoint_domain: RGB uint8 256x256 produced by authoritative wam_pipeline.data.resize_rgb

selection_inputs_allowed: public split episode identifiers and arm labels
source_boundary.authoritative_selection_source: public train40 HDF5 joint_action/vector plus seed.txt; prepare and every generator start/resume must re-hash the frozen split/seed evidence, independently rederive train40/right15 and every context arm/instruction/seed mapping, and require source_hdf5 to equal dataset/data/episode{episode}.hdf5; simulator replay creates fresh contexts/endpoints and no derived window cache is required or consulted

action_only_selection.eligible_window: history=A[s:s+4], future=A[s+4:s+12], history[-1,13]<0.5 and every future[:,13]<0.5, all values finite
action_only_selection.motion: sum_t L2(q[t]-q[t-1]) over q[-1]=history[-1,7:13] and q[0:8]=future[:,7:13]

strata.phase_assignment: inside each fold, sort every finite post-close eligible window by phase then full SHA256/episode/start and assign rank quintiles
strata.motion_assignment: inside each fold and phase bin, sort every eligible window by motion then full SHA256/episode/start and assign conditional rank quartiles
strata.selection_margins: after applying the v461 action-difference filter before recomputing fold-local rank bins, the real action-only feasibility probe proves exact phase8/motion10 remains feasible; each fold selects exactly40 with every phase bin exactly8 and every conditional-motion bin exactly10; no relaxed selection margins are authorized
strata.batch_margins: a second exact MILP assigns 10 batches; every batch has 20 contexts and exactly4 from every fold, with every phase bin in [3,5] and every motion bin in [4,6]

action_only_selection.episode_bounds: after the v461 action-difference filter and fold-local rebinning, action-only MILP searches the greatest feasible uniform episode lower bound and then the smallest feasible uniform upper bound under exact fold40/phase8/motion10/nonadjacent constraints; the proven interval is [6,17], after which it finds the minimum feasible actual max-minus-min range 11 and freezes the full-SHA rank optimum
action_only_selection.assignment: selection records successful exact phase8/motion10 feasibility after eligibility-before-binning, then satisfies fold40, fold-phase8, fold-motion10, episode[6,17] and no adjacent starts, minimizing actual episode-count range 11 then full-SHA rank sum; batch exact MILP satisfies batch20, batch-fold4, batch-phase[3,5] and batch-motion[4,6]; both sort variables by complete SHA256 uint256 then episode/start (and batch for batch stage), under scipy 1.15.3 / HiGHS 1.8.0 with threads=1, parallel=false, random_seed=1609, presolve=true and mip_rel_gap=0; solver warnings entering receipts are canonical codes with sorted option names and any unknown warning fails closed
action_only_selection.tie_break: complete uint256 SHA256 first, then episode, then start when assigning the unique preregistered rank objective
action_only_selection.infeasible_action_only_assignment: hard stop; do not inspect RGB, reward or outcomes to relax quotas

counterfactuals.unchanged_columns: 0:7 and 13 retain factual values in every counterfactual

pre_simulator_hard_gates: all six branch action tensors are finite and inside per-dimension public-train40 action bounds

before eligible statistics, rank bins or either MILP, each of the four counterfactuals must have right6 endpoint L2 >=0.01 and right6 full-path tensor L2 >=0.01 versus factual; both values are retained in the selection receipt
factual_duplicate is exactly equal to factual

exactly 200 unique episode/start rows; each fold40 with phase8x5 and motion10x4; every episode count is inside proven interval [6,17] at minimum feasible global count range11; same-episode starts are non-adjacent; every batch has fold4x5, phase counts [3,5] and motion counts [4,6]

paired_endpoint_collection.duplicate_use: determinism/noise audit only; never a second training target
paired_endpoint_collection.saved_payload: one shared context snapshot plus each branch action tensor and RGB256/state/bottle endpoint after exactly eight actions

collection_gate.failure_behavior: write a failed receipt and stop before v169 baseline generation or training; retain every selected row

paired_endpoint_collection.recovery: uncommitted worker directories are never deleted or reused; before resume they are atomically moved under REG/_forensic_uncommitted/batch_XXX/<timestamp-hash>, each with a quarantine receipt; on any exception all workers undergo terminate, bounded join, kill-if-alive, final join and an atomic root-level batch failure receipt records exception/resource/PIDs/cleanup; committed batch trees contain exactly rows/ plus batch_report.json

appearance_baseline.per_sample_input: the identical context/history and that branch's exact eight-action tensor
appearance_baseline.intermediate_frames: v169 frames 0:7 are appearance outputs but never endpoint-residual training targets

endpoint_residual_head.architecture: single-endpoint ResidualUNet128FiLM derived from the frozen v446 topology, not its weights
endpoint_residual_head.visual_input: v169 endpoint RGB plus last context RGB, six channels, downsampled to 128
endpoint_residual_head.action_condition: four history plus eight future 14D actions, normalized from fit-fold public-train actions only; explicit anchor-relative right6 endpoint/path features and post-close phase
endpoint_residual_head.output: one 3-channel 128x128 float residual, bilinear upsampled to 256x256
endpoint_residual_head.residual_parameterization: 255*tanh(raw); train and audit on float clip(v169_endpoint+residual,0,255) without rounding
endpoint_residual_head.target: simulator RGB256 endpoint; no target rounding, STE, reward, mask, handcrafted RGB cap or deployment gate during fitting
endpoint_residual_head.fixed_models_trained_before_audit: five episode-OOF action-conditioned heads, five same-capacity context-only controls, five fixed within-episode phase-shuffle controls, and one all-200 final head

before_any_promotion_audit: hash all model weights, training code, normalized action statistics, folds, row receipt and v169 dependency
prohibit optimizer restart, hyperparameter change, row filtering or alternate checkpoint selection

recursive_factual.selection: action-only preregistered public-train OOF post-close 32-action chains; no counterfactual or reward selection

runtime_contract.first_call: compute the complete frozen-v169 eight-frame prediction
runtime_contract.left_instruction: return v169 output bit-exact for all eight frames
runtime_contract.right_gate0: return v169 output bit-exact for all eight frames
runtime_contract.right_postclose_gate1: frames 0:7 remain v169 bit-exact; apply the unique frozen residual head only to frame index 7; clip and round once to uint8

promotion.on_all_pass: authorize packaging and a separate short raw-Pi0.5 zero-update parent diagnostic only; formal RL remains raw Pi0.5 fresh official fixed-budget and requires a separate preregistration
promotion.on_any_fail: stop the lineage; do not inspect development/final/hidden, tune on reward, change policy actions or launch RL
